lead.t: Defects of the complement system (C5-C8) are associated with recurrent meningococcal infection, and defects of the properdin system are associated with a significant risk of lethal meningococcal disease.

qs.q: During which seasonal period are cases of meningococcal disease noted to be more common, likely related to viral co-infections?
qs.e: Meningococcal cases are more common during flu season, likely due to associations with viral infections including influenza. Other seasonal windows are not highlighted in relation to meningococcal outbreaks.

qs.q: What is the significance of leukopenia in a child with suspected meningococcal disease?
o: It is a normal finding in neonates
It suggests a partially treated infection
qs.e: The note states that leukopenia in the context of suspected meningococcal disease signifies the worst prognosis. Leukocytosis is more common in typical bacterial infections.
